purpose: Operational clarification of the frozen anchors; not an answer key or a replacement score rule.

observation_statuses.observed: The evaluated subject record is available. Evaluate its actual claims and omissions against available independent evidence; do not attribute source facts to the subject unless the record says them.
observation_statuses.unavailable: The evaluator could not obtain the subject record. This is unknown with null score and null major-error judgment, even if background source facts are available. It does not prove a subject omission.
observation_statuses.verified-absent: A complete, provenance-verified subject deliverable was inspected and the required section or action is absent. This is an observed omission, judged under the relevant anchor; absence alone does not establish a major-error category.

major_error_rules.fabricated-evidence: An affirmative invented source, observation, result or data fact is presented as evidence. Unsupported hype, anticipated benefit or complexity alone receives the value anchor without automatically becoming fabricated evidence.
major_error_rules.false-verification: An affirmative central source or verification claim is contradicted by the supplied evidence, including asserting equivalent populations, measures or time scales to infer a false central comparison. A mere incomplete comparison is not automatically a major error.
major_error_rules.unsupported-central-novelty: An affirmative central novelty claim ignores established equivalent precedent or treats an incomplete search as proof that no precedent exists.
major_error_rules.hidden-hard-blocker: The subject affirmatively recommends execution while ignoring a known enabling material, validation or resource blocker. Recommending joint execution despite a proven aggregate resource excess qualifies. Offering alternatives separately with incomplete tradeoffs is scored by the portfolio anchor and is not automatically joint execution.
major_error_rules.unauthorized-scope-change: The subject makes a material scope choice contrary to or beyond the recorded user authorization; exploring alternatives does not itself change the authorized scope.
major_error_rules.exploratory-as-confirmatory: The subject presents exploratory or post-selected evidence as if it supported a prespecified confirmatory conclusion. A novel method's unmeasured effect may legitimately be a future research question.

decision_order: Identify the evaluated subject, version, claim and observed record availability.
Compare the actual subject record to independent source evidence.
Apply the criterion anchor; keep evaluator failures separate from subject scientific errors.
Apply a major-error category only when its affirmative factual requirements are met.
